prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Dallas for a roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single universally “best” roofing company for everyone — the right contractor depends on your exact location, roof type, budget, whether you’re filing an insurance claim, and other preferences. I can help you find the best fit for your situation. First, here’s a quick checklist for choosing a top-quality Dallas roofer and some next steps I recommend.

What to look for in the “best” roofer
- Local reputation: strong Google/Yelp/Angi reviews and recent customer references.
- Certifications from major manufacturers (GAF Master Elite, CertainTeed SELECT ShingleMaster, Owens Corning Preferred, etc.).
- Proof of insurance (general liability and workers’ comp) and a business license/registration.
- Written, itemized estimates that specify brand, product line, warranty, scope of work, ventilation and decking repairs.
- Clear warranty: manufacturer warranty + company workmanship warranty (length and transferability).
- Handles permits and inspections, and provides lien waivers at job completion.
- Good communication, timely schedule, and a clean-up plan.
- No high-pressure sales or requirement for large upfront payment (common: small deposit, staged payments).

Red flags to avoid
- No physical address or only a P.O. box.
- Contractor asks for full (or very large) payment up front.
- No insurance proof or unwillingness to provide it.
- Only cash deals or unlicensed subcontractors.
- Extremely low bid compared to others without explanation.

How to pick the best company in Dallas
1. Narrow to contractors that service your ZIP code (roofers can be regional).  
2. Get at least 3 written estimates and compare materials, ventilation, scope, and warranty.  
3. Verify insurance and ask to see proof; call the insurer to confirm coverage is current.  
4. Ask for references and photos of recent similar jobs; contact those homeowners.  
5. Check for manufacturer certifications and BBB/Angi ratings.  
6. If using insurance, confirm the roofer has experience with claims and will work with your adjuster.

If you want, I can:
- Find the top-rated roofing companies in your specific Dallas ZIP code (I’ll list 3–5 with ratings, specialties, and contact links), or
- Walk you through questions to ask each contractor or help compare 2–3 written estimates you already have.

Tell me your ZIP code and any preferences (roof material, insurance claim, budget), and I’ll pull tailored recommendations.
